reason: B provides the clearer, falsifiable proposal: systematically varying interfacial lattice misfit under matched creep conditions predicts measurable changes in creep rate, strain localization, and interface integrity. Although it risks overextending γ/γ′ evidence to FCC/BCC interfaces and composition-based misfit tuning may introduce confounders, A lacks a true controlled comparison and relies on a less decisive, broadly stated interface-dislocation mechanism.
